text:
Alex Chen: Heads up—NexCore emailed: they want to move their commit from 200k -> 350k tokens/mo and asked for a 15% discount. Renewal in 9 days. They also want a short on-prem POC for data locality.

Maria Ortiz: Copy. Do we have usage telemetry confirming sustained 320k/mo or is that bursty? Need that to argue for lift without full discount.

Alex Chen: Usage shows steady 310-340k last 3 months. They say competitors offered 15% but without true-up protections.

Devon Patel: On-prem POC note 30d trial possible but infra cost applies. We'll need SSO + HSM/KMS details. Security questionnaire incoming?

security-bot: NexCore_sec_q_v3 submitted by Alex (link). Outstanding items: KMS proof, retention controls, export control checkbox.

Jamie Larkin: Quick margin check: current list $0.0006/token at 200k commit. If we increase to 350k and give 15% off list, blended rev/token ~ $0.00051. That drives margin below policy for this account tier.

Maria Ortiz: Suggestion: counter on price: 12% off committed tier + mid-year true-up + one-time onboarding fee for on-prem POC to cover infra. Keeps margins and we stay competitive.

Alex Chen: Draft counter to present to customer: 350k commit, 12% off committed price, 12-month term, mid-year true-up (single true-down cap in year 1), 30-day on-prem POC with one-time infra fee $6k.

Finance (pricing): We can approve up to 12% for >1.5x commit with approval. $6k POC fee covers infra/ops time for a short trial. Confirming unit econ at 12% looks OK.

Jamie Larkin: If legal accepts true-down cap language and finance signs off, I can greenlight. Need Deal Desk ticket and full margin calc with uplift guarantee baked in.

Legal (triage): True-down cap language idea OK. We'll draft clause: "Customer may request one downward adjustment to committed tokens during first 12 months; subsequent reductions require 30 days' notice and are subject to review." Will need to see final wording in the quote.

Claire - AE Success: I'll check with NexCore on scheduling the 30-day window and get their network contacts. Also confirm they'll supply the HSM vendor details.

Alex Chen: Putting proposed rate snippet for Deal Desk:

```
current:
  commit: 200000 tokens/mo @ $0.0006/token
proposal:
  commit: 350000 tokens/mo @ $0.000528/token  # 12% off list
POC:
  30-day on-prem trial, one-time infra fee $6000
terms:
  12 mo term, mid-year true-up, true-down limited to one adjustment in first 12 months, 1.5x uplift min guarantee
```

Maria Ortiz: Nice. Add request: pricing committee approval required for >10% discount. Tag @Finance (pricing) and @Legal (triage) in Deal Desk.

Devon Patel: I'll prep SOW for POC and note ops runbook + network diagram required. Need infra lead to confirm no port blockers.

Jamie Larkin: I'll attach margin spreadsheet to Deal Desk. If finance approves 12% and the $6k POC fee is accepted, I can sign off by EOD.

Alex Chen: Action items: Maria open Deal Desk with terms + sec questionnaire; Jamie attach margins; Devon draft SOW; Claire book POC window; Legal to finalize clause. I'll message NexCore tomorrow with our counter (12% + POC fee + true-up guardrails).

Maria Ortiz: Submitting Deal Desk now. Will update thread with ticket number when done. :rocket:
